as-err-double-reference: Invalid parameter reference qualifier format for type '{}'.
as-err-duplicate-case-value: Duplicate case value '{}' in switch statement.
as-err-duplicate-symbol: Duplicate symbol declaration '{}' in the same scope.

as-err-expression-is-data-type: Type '{}' cannot be used as a value expression.

as-err-initializer-list-too-few: Not enough values to match pattern.

as-err-multi-class-inherit: Class '{}' cannot inherit from multiple classes.

as-err-no-default-constructor: Class '{}' does not have a default constructor.

as-hint-accessor-portability: Accessor for property '{}' has no `property` keyword. It is a property under asEP_PROPERTY_ACCESSOR_MODE 2 but not under mode 3, the engine's own default. Adding the keyword is accepted under both.

Call it explicitly, which compiles under both modes, or set angelscript.engine.boolConversionMode to 1 if your host does.
as-hint-file-in-several-modules: This file is in module '{}'. It is also inside {}, and a file is assigned to exactly one module here - the most specific claim wins: an entry point, then the deepest folder.
